title: drypetes arborescens
intro: Drypetes arborescens, commonly known as the Chinese candle plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Drypetes arborescens include wound healing, pain relief, and the management of various infections.
